hookText: Pizza history: AI agent's cardless purchase is a first

beats.say: An AI agent has made a cardless purchase in the UK for the first time, ordering a pizza without a human entering any payment details.
Of course the agent suggested different flavours and quantities.
Papa John’s AI agent was set to work with a strict mandate established with Lloyds, including a maximum spend limit per transaction and per month, with no account security information shared.
